title: app/mcpResourceTemplates
description: MCP resource templates. Keys are resource template names.

uriTemplate.description: An RFC 6570 URI template. Resource URIs are matched against it, extracted variables are passed to the params class. E.g. `espo://Attachment/{id}`.

definitionProviderClassName.description: Provides the resource template definition. Should implement `Espo\Modules\Mcp\Tools\ResourceTemplate\DefinitionProvider`.

paramsClassName.description: Params created from a resource URI and passed to the reader. Should implement `Espo\Modules\Mcp\Tools\ResourceTemplate\Params`.
